objective: Client Notes Page, Modal, Sidebar Entry & Route Guard
must_haves: A NavItem { to: '/client-notes', icon: NotebookPen, label: 'Client Notes', minRole: 'PM' } is added to the Tools group in Sidebar.tsx — visible to PM and ADMIN, filtered out for NORMAL by the existing item.minRole filter (no filter-logic change).

App.tsx registers <Route path='/client-notes' element={<ClientNotes />}/> INSIDE a <Route element={<RoleProtectedRoute minRole='PM' />}> wrapper (reusing the existing guard at App.tsx:41-62), placed within the authenticated <ProtectedRoute> block; a NORMAL user navigating directly to /client-notes is redirected to '/' (not merely a hidden link) and sees the 'Access denied' toast.

ClientNotes page lists EVERY client via the existing useClients() hook rendered in a @/components/ui/table (colour swatch + name columns, mirroring ClientManager), with Board.tsx-style isLoading skeleton and isError + Retry states; a row click opens the modal via a ?client={id} URL search param (Board.tsx pattern), and clearing it closes the modal.

ClientNotesModal fetches the selected client's notes via useClientNotes(clientId), renders the shared @/components/NotesEditor (Edit/Preview) seeded with those notes, shows the client's name + colour (no projects), and saves via useUpdateClientNotes wired as onSave={(notes) => updateClientNotes.mutateAsync({ id: clientId, notes })} with isSaving={updateClientNotes.isPending}; after save the refreshed attribution appears with no page reload.

The modal resolves notesUpdatedBy to a display name via useBoardMembers() (allMembers.find(u => u.id === notesUpdatedBy) ?? m.displayName ?? m.username), passing the resolved NAME (or null) to NotesEditor's notesUpdatedBy prop — never a raw user id. This cross-feature reuse of the board hook (endpoint /api/board/members is generic user data, requireAuth-only) is intentional and commented as such.
No backend/** file is modified; no projects/search fetch, hook, or features/projects/ directory is introduced (name + colour only).
